body: folklore's whole thesis is one line taylor wrote in the album announcement: "a single thread that, for better or for worse, ties you to your fate." "invisible string" makes it literal -- years of near-misses traced back to reading in the grass at nashville's centennial park. on an album of invented characters, the one that's just... quietly, plainly happy.
